title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.7.0 adds Waves 12–13A (5,471 new lines across 4 strictly additive modules under PakStokes/AllD/, bringing PakStokesAllD to 28,422 lines across 17 modules, with 175 new public declarations / 135 public theorems), proved 100% unconditionally from Mathlib with zero external hypotheses: (1) Physical Relativistic Blackbody Photon Gases in 2D, 3D, and 4D (BlackbodyPhotons3D.lean, 1,530 lines, 57 public decls / 40 theorems): exact lattice-sphere counts r2Count/r3Count/r4Count, elementary 3-class square-free core separation (Fermat 1 mod 4, constructive Q^2 + 2 sequence s = 3 mod 8 with r_3(k^2 s) >= 1 and r_2(k^2 s) = 0, Lagrange four-square), exact analytic regrouping identity on t > 0 (photonEnergyAnalytic_eq_tsum_sqrt), triangular core-separation transseries engine (triangular_core_transseries_diff_indep), individual non-ADE (photon2D_non_ade, photon3D_non_ade, photon4D_non_ade), and joint {2D, 3D, 4D} differential independence of internal energies and grand potentials over AsympCoeff and C[t] (photon2D_photon3D_photon4D_joint_diff_indep, photon2D_photon3D_photon4D_all_derivs_diff_indep, photon2D_photon3D_photon4D_no_joint_poly_ade, photonLogZ_2D_3D_4D_joint_diff_indep); (2) Mock-Modular Algebraic, Bol/Modular Independence, & Watson Uniqueness Core (MockModularAlgebraCore.lean, 2,238 lines, 54 public decls / 44 theorems): exact symbolic Mock-Modular Vandermonde determinant (mockModular_jet_det_eq) & analytic mode derivatives (iteratedDeriv_mockModular_mode), exact polynomial translation-invariance minimality theorem killing linear-rate collisions (mockModular_translation_invariance_kills_linear_collisions, mockModular_minimal_annihilator_contradiction, mockModular_jump_induction_contradiction), exact Bol/modular iterated-derivative transformation law & Universal Positive-Weight Modular Differential Independence across mixed positive integer and half-integer weights (modular_iteratedDeriv_gamma, positiveWeight_modular_forms_diff_indep, positiveWeight_modular_thetaQ_diff_indep), and Maximum Modulus Watson Uniqueness on {||z|| >= R_0, |arg z| <= 2pi/3} (maxModulus_watson_uniqueness); (3) All-Moduli Dyson Folded-Cycle & Real Trigonometric Shadow Rank r_N (DysonShadowRank.lean, 1,033 lines, 47 public decls / 34 theorems): Bringmann-Ono trigonometric shadow identity (dyson_shadow_trig_identity), folded-cycle graph connected-component count (dysonFoldedGraph_connectedComponent_card), exact linear shadow rank over any field K (dysonShadowRank_eq: floor(N/2) if 3 does not divide N, N/3 if 3 divides N), exact kernel characterization and single-residue non-vanishing (mem_shadowKernel_iff_const_on_components, single_vertex_not_mem_shadowKernel, dysonShadowRank_six, dysonSix_triple_zero_shadow), and real trigonometric sine-product shadow matrix rank via discrete cosine orthogonality (dct_orthogonality, dysonTrigShadowRank_eq); and (4) Dual-Ray Prime-Frequency Dilation Isolation & Block Elimination (PrimeDilationIsolation.lean, 670 lines, 17 theorems): exact prime-square isolation (no_sq_mul_eq_prime_sq_mul_of_gt, prime_dilation_freq_ne), non-vanishing sin(pi p / 3) = +- sqrt(3)/2 for primes p > 3 (mockFalse_sine_factor_eq, mockFalse_sine_factor_ne_zero), arbitrarily many strictly increasing isolated primes (exists_isolated_primes_for_max_dilation), symbolic/pointwise/weighted mock-modular jet Vandermonde nonsingularity (prime_dilation_jet_det_ne_zero, prime_dilation_weighted_jet_det_ne_zero), descending block elimination (prime_dilation_block_elimination), and dual-ray mock/false-theta joint elimination (dual_ray_prime_dilation_elimination, dual_ray_prime_dilation_constant). Modules (2)-(4) formalize the exact algebraic, Watson-uniqueness, Bol/modular independence, all-moduli Dyson shadow rank r_N, and Appendix A prime-dilation cores of the companion mock-modular classification preprint (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24590300). All 423 audited declarations in Verify.lean (288 Waves 1-11 + 100% of all 135 public theorems across Waves 12-13A) depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
